issues.description: The PR moves CPU-layout equalities from a temporary trusted helper into mandatory PagingConstsTrait requirements, preventing a valid three-level IOMMU configuration from satisfying the trait.
issues.rationale: `PagingConstsTrait` is the common abstraction for paging layouts, but this historical head requires every implementation to prove equality with the build-selected CPU constants, including `Self::NR_LEVELS() == NR_LEVELS`. The review discussion establishes that `IommuPtConfig` implements the relevant paging configuration and uses three levels, whereas the current CPU layout uses a different level count. The author explicitly confirmed that this version does not work for IOMMU and promised to revise it. Consequently, the contract is not merely stronger than necessary: it excludes a supported implementation. The final PR head removes these CPU-specific equalities from the generic requirements and retains layout-independent range and power-of-two constraints. Follow-up diff check: the base isolates these equalities in external_body axiom_current_paging_consts_hardcoded; this revision deletes that helper and adds the equalities to the mandatory requirements. This distinct migration makes the restriction an implementation proof obligation, unlike #530/#532; retain its own repair-backed case.
